## R Markdown

This is an R Markdown document. Markdown is a simple formatting syntax for authoring HTML, PDF, and MS Word documents. For more details on using R Markdown see <http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com>.

When you click the **Knit** button a document will be generated that includes both content as well as the output of any embedded R code chunks within the document. You can embed an R code chunk like this:

```{r cars}
summary(cars)
```

## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
plot(pressure)
```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
NB_data <- read_csv("NHANES_20212023_codebook_filtered 1.csv")
NB_data
# geeft uitleg over wat de variabelen betekenen
# 486 rijen × 4 kolommen (1 rij per variabele)

# comment code: 0 wilt zeggen dat het
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
NB_data_merged <- read_csv("NHANES_20212023_merged_filtered 1.csv")
NB_data_merged
#Dit is de daadwerkelijke meetwaarde van de 11.933 deelnemers, 1 rij per persoon
```

```{r}
missing_summary <- NB_data_merged %>%
# new tible
  summarise(across(everything(), ~sum(is.na(.)))) %>%
  # for each column seen which cells are empty and count these
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Missing_Values") %>%
  mutate(Missing_Percentage = (Missing_Values / nrow(NB_data_merged)) * 100) %>%
  arrange(desc(Missing_Percentage))

print(missing_summary,n = 486)

#hoeveel bij BMXBMI

```
```{r}
missing_summary %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Variable, Missing_Percentage), y = Missing_Percentage)) +
  geom_col(fill = "blue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Percentage of Missing Values by Variable", x = "Variables", y = "Percentage of Missing Values") +
  theme_minimal()
```
  
```{r}
missing_summary %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Variable, Missing_Percentage), y = Missing_Percentage)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 50, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Percentage of Missing Values by Variable (Threshold = 50%)",
    x = "Variables (486 total)",
    y = "Percentage of Missing Values"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r}
missing_summary %>%
  filter(Variable %in% c("BMXBMI", "BPXOSY1", "RIAGENDR", "RIDAGEYR"))
```
